title: Joe Wilder tells off Hampton; his classical background
summary: Joe Wilder, mild-mannered and always warmed up early, fell out with Hampton over a rehearsal; Cobb notes Wilder was a trained cornetist who once sat in with Dizzy.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

Dog Gablits, that's a cussing word for him.

One of the sweetest and finest guys you ever want to meet in your life --
Yeah, but you'd never think he would be the one to -- I mean he's usually very quiet, isn't he?
